decisions.decision: Defer gamepad LB/RB fix to new 32-04 plan (XInput bridge) rather than restore gameButtonLeft1/Right1
decisions.rationale: Profile diagnostic on user's real Windows+Xbox hardware proved gamepad buttons (LB/RB/A/B/X/Y) do NOT arrive at Focus.onKeyEvent as KeyEvents — only D-pad, remapped to keyboard arrows (HID page 0x07 usages 0x4F/0x50/0x51/0x52), arrives. gameButtonLeft1/Right1/12/13 are Android-derived (Android surfaces gamepad as keycodes 102/103/199/200); Windows desktop Flutter does not route XInput buttons through the Focus/KeyEvent system. Restoring gameButtonLeft1/Right1 would NOT fix it (events never reach the handler regardless of key name). The 32-01 premise 'gameButton13/12 = Windows direct mapping of shoulders' is FALSIFIED. Fix is architectural: XInputGetState via existing window_bridge MethodChannel (com.simple_player/window) -> new GamepadService (mirror PositionPoller timer-poll pattern) -> controller.prevTab/nextTab. No new pub dependency; matches Win32-bridge architecture. Plan Task 2 Step 5 explicitly permits deferring the gamepad sub-check and noting it in the summary.

decisions.decision: Applied BP3 fixed extraction override to the 32-03 regression gate
decisions.rationale: The plan <verify> block ships a broken extraction (grep -E without -a binary-safe flag + sed missing the ~[0-9]+ skipped-count group). Asymmetric extraction would have produced a false regression diff.
